CREATE TABLE personal_teacher_soul (
    personal_teacher_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    persona_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    voice_style VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    relationship_style VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    encouragement_style VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(display_name) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(persona_code) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(voice_style) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(relationship_style) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(encouragement_style) <> ''),
    CHECK (updated_at >= created_at)
);

INSERT INTO personal_teacher_soul (
    personal_teacher_id,
    student_id,
    display_name,
    persona_code,
    voice_style,
    relationship_style,
    encouragement_style,
    version,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    'Mentor',
    'patient_mentor',
    'clear_supportive',
    'respectful_collaborative',
    'evidence_based',
    1,
    created_at,
    updated_at
FROM personal_teacher;
